fields.description: Game mode value produced by FUN_08002da8 (0/1/2 from work-struct byte +0x38 threshold 0x12 and flag) and stored by serializer FUN_08001ea0 as record word 0 low half.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001ea0 stores FUN_08002da8 result into record u16 +0x00; FUN_08001e14 clamps u16 +0x00 to <=2.
fields.name: slot0_mode

fields.description: Story progress episode byte: high nibble is episode index 0..2, low nibble sub-flags. Varies 0x00/0x10/0x20 across the used slot records.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001e14 enforces ((byte)param_1[1]>>4)<=2, i.e. byte +0x02 <=0x2F; FUN_08001ea0 copies work-struct byte +0x02 here; baseline shows 0x00, 0x10, 0x20 in records at 0x18/0x58/0x98.
fields.name: slot0_episode

fields.description: Story progress stage byte within episode. Varies 0/1/2 across the used slot records.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001e14 clamps byte +0x03 to <=2 (reset 2); FUN_08001ea0 copies work-struct byte +0x03 here; baseline shows 0, 1, 2 in records at 0x18/0x58/0x98.
fields.name: slot0_stage

fields.description: Progress/area byte clamped to 0..0x12 by the save validator.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001e14 clamps byte +0x04 to <=0x12; FUN_08001ea0 copies work-struct byte +0x04 here; baseline value 0.
fields.name: slot0_area_a

fields.description: Progress/area byte clamped to 0..0x11 by the save validator.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001e14 clamps byte +0x05 to <=0x11; FUN_08001ea0 copies work-struct byte +0x05 here; baseline value 0.
fields.name: slot0_area_b

fields.description: Counter byte capped at 99 by the save validator (collectible/count style field).
fields.evidence: FUN_08001e14 clamps byte +0x06 to <=99; FUN_08001ea0 copies work-struct byte +0x06 here; baseline value 0.
fields.name: slot0_collectible

fields.description: Option/flag byte clamped to 0..3 (reset to 1) by the save validator.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001e14 clamps byte +0x07 to <=3 (reset 1); FUN_08001ea0 copies work-struct byte +0x07 here; baseline value 1.
fields.name: slot0_option

fields.description: Stock counter (default 2, valid range 2..6) enforced by init and validator.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002df8 inits record byte +0x08 to 2; FUN_08001e14 enforces ((char)param_1[4]-2)<=4 i.e. 2..6; baseline value 2 in all four records.
fields.name: slot0_stock

fields.description: Opaque u32 copied from work-struct offset +0x0c by the serializer; zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001ea0 copies u32 work+0x0c to record +0x0c; covered by FUN_08002f18 checksum.
fields.name: slot0_work_c

fields.description: Opaque u32 copied from work-struct offset +0x10 by the serializer; zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001ea0 copies u32 work+0x10 to record +0x10; covered by FUN_08002f18 checksum.
fields.name: slot0_work_d

fields.description: Save/play counter: serializer increments work-struct byte +0x1c and stores it here.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001ea0 does work+0x1c++ then param_1[10]=that byte (record +0x14); baseline value 1 in all records.
fields.name: slot0_save_count

fields.description: Opaque 8-byte block copied from work-struct +0x38 by FUN_08002f5c; zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001ea0 calls FUN_08002f5c(record+0x1c, work+0x38) copying 8 bytes; covered by FUN_08002f18 checksum.
fields.name: slot0_mid_block

fields.description: Opaque 8-byte block copied from work-struct +0x24 by FUN_08002f38; zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001ea0 calls FUN_08002f38(record+0x24, work+0x24) copying 8 bytes; covered by FUN_08002f18 checksum.
fields.name: slot0_mid_block2

fields.description: Single flag byte copied from work-struct +0x51 by FUN_08002f6c; zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001ea0 calls FUN_08002f6c(record+0x2c, work+0x50) copying work byte +0x51; covered by FUN_08002f18 checksum.
fields.name: slot0_flag

fields.description: Opaque 12-byte tail block copied from work-struct +0x6c by FUN_08002f74; zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001ea0 calls FUN_08002f74(record+0x30, work+0x6c) copying 12 bytes; covered by FUN_08002f18 checksum.
